jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineering Manager - Cardiac Ablation Solutions
jobs.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 8 Sep 2026

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

The Senior Engineering Manager, Software Development will lead a team responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software for the Affera mapping system. This role will provide technical leadership, people management, and cross-functional execution oversight to deliver safe, high-quality, and innovative software solutions that support product performance, regulatory compliance, and business objectives.

The ideal candidate will have deep experience leading software engineering teams in a regulated environment, with strong expertise in software architecture, product development, testing methodologies, and team development.

About The Affera Mapping And Ablation System

The Affera Mapping and Ablation System is an innovative medical technology designed to treat patients with cardiac arrhythmias. The system involves advanced mapping techniques to create detailed images of the heart's electrical activity, helping physicians identify abnormal areas causing arrhythmias. Once identified, the Affera Ablation System delivers targeted energy to disrupt these abnormal signals, restoring normal heart rhythm.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a high-performing software engineering team responsible for core product software.
Define technical direction, development priorities, and execution plans in alignment with product and business strategy.
Support planning and execution of release milestones, risk management, defect resolution, and continuous improvement.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Recruit, coach, mentor, and retain engineering talent.
Champion best practices in software development, architecture, cybersecurity, testability, and documentation.
Contribute to product strategy through technical assessment, roadmap input, and tradeoff analysis.

Required Qualifications:

Experience with Python and C++
Bachelor's degree and minimum of 7 years of relevant experience with 5+ years of managerial experience
OR advanced degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience with 5+ years of managerial experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with embedded software, real-time systems, imaging, mapping, or medical device platforms.
Familiarity with software quality processes and regulatory frameworks relevant to medical devices.
Preference for working with agile development methodologies.
Prior leadership in platform or product software organizations with multiple contributors and dependencies.
Experience supporting fielded products, sustaining engineering, and post-market software issues.

jobs.description:

Job details:
Remote, FinTech, Azure Environment

This Jobot Job is hosted by: Dylan Currier
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
and sending us your resume.
Salary: $180,000 - $225,000 per year

A bit about us:

Our client is a growing B2B software company undergoing a significant technology transformation. They are modernizing their technology environment, strengthening their security and compliance programs, and building scalable infrastructure to support continued growth.

This is a hands-on leadership and builder role for someone who enjoys creating and maturing an IT organization rather than simply maintaining an established environment. The Director will have broad ownership across cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, IT operations, compliance, business continuity, and technology governance.

The ideal candidate can operate strategically while remaining technical enough to jump into the details when needed. You will establish scalable processes, automate wherever possible, introduce the right technology, and lead a lean team of experienced technical professionals.

Why join us?

Success in this role means building an IT and security organization that becomes more scalable, automated, secure, and cost-efficient as the company grows.

You will establish the infrastructure and security foundation needed to support growth, reduce operational friction, strengthen customer trust, improve compliance readiness, and enable employees and Engineering to move faster without compromising security or reliability.

Job Details

What You'll Own
Infrastructure & Cloud
Lead the company's cloud infrastructure, networking, internal IT, hardware, and technology platforms, with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure.
Build and manage automated infrastructure across development, testing, UAT, staging, and production environments.
Establish infrastructure-as-code, automation, and self-service provisioning as core operating practices.
Oversee AI infrastructure, tooling, access, subscriptions, and related controls.
Own the API gateway and platform layer, including routing, access management, rate limiting, security enforcement, and observability.
Develop an integrated observability strategy across infrastructure, databases, APIs, and applications.
Manage the company's SaaS and software portfolio, including licensing, renewals, vendors, and cost optimization.
Establish FinOps practices to improve visibility and efficiency across cloud and SaaS spending.

Cybersecurity
Own the organization's infrastructure and cybersecurity strategy.
Build and mature SIEM, detection, monitoring, and security response capabilities.
Manage relationships with external MDR/MSSP providers supporting 24/7 security coverage.
Implement endpoint security and modern device management for a primarily Windows-based remote workforce.
Lead identity and access governance through Microsoft Entra ID, including least privilege, access reviews, privileged access, and segregation of duties.

Governance, Risk & Compliance
Own the company's SOC 2 program, including controls, evidence collection, audits, and auditor relationships.
Lead SOX IT general controls and ensure effective design and execution.
Develop data protection, classification, retention, and residency policies for an international customer base.
Ensure compliance with applicable privacy requirements, including GDPR and CCPA.
Establish an AI governance framework using recognized standards such as NIST AI RMF, NIST SSDF, and OWASP guidance.
Develop practical governance around the responsible use of AI throughout the organization.

IT Operations & Reliability
Own business continuity and disaster recovery, including backups, RTO/RPO objectives, and regular testing.
Establish incident management processes covering security, IT, and platform availability.
Develop severity models, escalation procedures, runbooks, on-call processes, and post-incident reviews.
Own release management and deployment governance, including release calendars, go/no-go decisions, deployment coordination, validation, and rollback procedures.
Manage IT assets, hardware, software, licenses, and technology vendors.
Establish scalable onboarding, offboarding, access management, and internal IT processes.

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience across IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud engineering, or a related discipline.
3+ years of experience leading and developing technical teams.
Experience in a B2B SaaS, multi-tenant software, or technology environment strongly preferred.
Deep hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, automation, and modern cloud operations.
Demonstrated success building or significantly maturing cybersecurity capabilities, including SIEM, detection, identity/access governance, and endpoint security.
Experience leading SOC 2, SOX ITGC, or comparable compliance programs.
Understanding of cloud and SaaS cost management and FinOps principles.
An automation-first mindset with strong judgment around technology investments.
Strong operational discipline and the ability to turn policies into repeatable processes, documentation, runbooks, and automation.
Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience implementing AI governance using frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or OWASP LLM/GenAI guidance.
Experience with API gateway or API management platforms.
Experience implementing modern observability platforms.
Experience managing an MDR or MSSP relationship.
Experience with zero-trust and remote-first technology environments.
Experience supporting hybrid SaaS and on-premise deployment models.
Strong Azure security and architecture experience.
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Azure Solutions Architect, or Azure Security Engineer.

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering — Cloud, DevOps & AI Modernization (Onsite) Overland Park, KS
jobs.description:
About Netsmart

At Netsmart, we are focused on moving healthcare forward through technology that supports providers, clinicians, clients, and communities. As healthcare continues to evolve, our engineering teams are modernizing platforms, strengthening cloud-based delivery, improving DevOps practices, and exploring responsible AI-enabled capabilities that create meaningful value across our solutions.

About The Role

Netsmart is seeking a Vice President, Engineering — Cloud, DevOps & AI Modernization to lead software engineering teams through the next stage of modernization and scale. This is a senior engineering leadership role for someone who has grown through software development, understands how complex applications are built and operated, and can lead teams through cloud transformation, DevOps maturity, and AI-aware product evolution.

This leader will provide strategic and operational leadership across engineering, partnering closely with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, Data, and business stakeholders. The right candidate will bring strong software development credibility, cloud experience, DevOps leadership, a strong culture-first mindset, and experience working with global/offshore engineering teams, including teams in India.

This role is onsite in Overland Park, KS, and candidates must live in or relocate to the Greater Kansas City metro area.

What You’ll Do

Engineering Leadership & Culture

Lead and scale high-performing software engineering teams with a focus on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and delivery discipline.
Build a strong engineering culture rooted in ownership, trust, transparency, continuous improvement, and practical innovation.
Coach and develop engineering leaders and teams while creating clarity around priorities, expectations, decision-making, and execution.
Partner across Netsmart’s matrixed organization to align engineering priorities with business goals, client needs, product strategy, and operational commitments.
Serve as a credible, hands-on executive who can engage with teams at both the strategic and technical level.

Software Development & Modernization

Lead engineering execution across complex enterprise software platforms, balancing current-state application realities with future-state modernization goals.
Guide teams through legacy application modernization, platform scalability, service decomposition, API-first design, architectural simplification, and cloud-readiness.
Strengthen engineering practices across design, development, code quality, testing, security, reliability, observability, and production support.
Partner with architecture and engineering leaders to establish reusable patterns, standards, and practices that improve consistency and speed across teams.
Ensure teams can deliver stable, secure, scalable solutions while continuing to modernize core platforms over time.

Cloud, DevOps & Operational Excellence

Drive cloud and DevOps maturity across engineering teams, including CI/CD, automation, infrastructure-as-code, deployment reliability, monitoring, observability, and incident readiness.
Partner with DevOps, Cloud, Hosting, Security, and Infrastructure teams to improve how software is built, deployed, operated, and optimized.
Guide engineering teams in building cloud-enabled solutions with a strong understanding of AWS, distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, and cost awareness.
Promote engineering practices that improve release confidence, production stability, operational efficiency, and developer productivity.
Help teams move from project-based transformation toward sustainable cloud and DevOps operating models.

AI-Aware Engineering & Future-Ready Development

Help engineering teams understand where AI, automation, analytics, and data-driven capabilities can responsibly improve products, workflows, development practices, and operational outcomes.
Partner with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and Architecture leaders to evaluate AI-enabled opportunities with appropriate governance, privacy, security, and risk considerations.
Support practical adoption of AI concepts in engineering, including intelligent automation, developer productivity, data-driven decision-making, and responsible AI-enabled product capabilities.
Balance innovation with execution discipline, ensuring AI opportunities are connected to measurable business, client, and product value.

Global Engineering Partnership

Lead effectively across distributed and global engineering teams, including teams in India.
Create strong alignment, communication rhythms, ownership models, and delivery expectations across U.S. and India-based teams.
Build trust and accountability across locations while ensuring teams are connected to shared architecture, engineering standards, product priorities, and delivery outcomes.
Operate successfully in a matrixed organization where influence, collaboration, and clarity are essential.

What You’ll Bring

Senior engineering leadership experience, ideally at the VP, Senior Director, Director, or equivalent level leading software engineering teams at scale.
Strong foundation in software development, software engineering leadership, application architecture, or technical delivery.
Experience leading complex enterprise software development organizations through modernization, cloud adoption, DevOps maturity, or platform transformation.
Strong understanding of AWS/cloud-based architecture, distributed systems, APIs, application modernization, cloud operations, scalability, reliability, and security.
Demonstrated experience advancing DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, observability, production readiness, and operational excellence.
Ability to lead engineering teams through ambiguity while creating clear priorities, execution plans, success measures, and accountability.
Experience partnering with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Security, Compliance, Data, and business leaders in a matrixed environment.
Experience working with India-based offshore or global capability center teams.
Practical understanding of AI concepts and how AI, automation, and data-driven capabilities can support product innovation and engineering optimization.
Strong culture leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and people development skills.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Must be onsite in Overland Park, KS and based in or willing to relocate to the Greater Kansas City metro area.

Preferred Experience

Healthcare technology, EHR, post-acute care, human services, behavioral health, revenue cycle, or regulated industry experience.
Experience leading cloud modernization or application transformation across legacy enterprise platforms.
Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, event-driven architecture, infrastructure-as-code, platform engineering, or modern data platforms.
Experience improving engineering operating models across U.S. and India-based teams.
Exposure to AI/ML, LLMs, MLOps, responsible AI practices, intelligent automation, or AI-assisted developer productivity.
Experience leading through organizational change while maintaining delivery commitments and production stability.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted engineering executive who can lead people, technology, and transformation with clarity and credibility. You will help Netsmart strengthen software engineering execution, modernize complex platforms, improve cloud and DevOps maturity, and prepare teams for responsible AI-enabled innovation.

You will be known for building strong engineering culture, creating operational discipline, partnering effectively across a matrixed organization, and leading both U.S. and India-based teams with alignment, accountability, and trust.

Why Netsmart

At Netsmart, you will help shape technology that supports healthcare providers, clinicians, organizations, and communities. This role offers the opportunity to lead meaningful engineering modernization work in a mission-driven company where cloud, DevOps, and AI-aware innovation are central to how we continue moving healthcare forward.

Netsmart is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all associates. All employment decisions at Netsmart, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion and transfer, are based on performance, qualifications, abilities, education and experience. Netsmart does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, past or present military service, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.description:
About Viam

Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We're inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.

We're a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.

About the Role

Hybrid 3 days/week in NYC office, with occasional travel to customer sites

We're looking for a Director of Forward Deployed Engineering to lead the team responsible for getting Viam's customers into production. You'll manage a team of five engineers working across our most strategic accounts, own the technical approach to each deployment, and serve as the senior technical partner to our customers' engineering and operations leaders.

This is a leadership role for someone who is still technical. You'll spend your time on architecture decisions, design reviews, coaching, and customer conversations. Prior professional robotics experience isn't required, but you should be comfortable around hardware and physical systems, and able to get fluent in a new platform quickly.

What you'll own:

Manage a team of five forward deployed engineers: coaching, performance, hiring, and how they are resourced across accounts.
Own the technical approach across deployments and make the architecture and prioritization calls.
Be the senior technical voice with customer leadership, from kickoff through escalation.
Work with Viam leadership on account direction, and keep them current on progress, risks, and blockers.
Drive deployments to production: hold the schedule, unblock what's stuck, and change approach when a site demands it.
Turn field learnings into platform priorities with Product and Engineering.

What you bring:

Experience managing engineers who deploy software in customer environments.
Deep systems experience and the ability to get fluent in an unfamiliar platform quickly. You can review a design and read code, though you won't be coding day to day.
Judgment across systems integration, SDKs, and edge/cloud architectures, including what breaks when networks and hardware are unreliable.
A track record with enterprise customers, including the credibility to hold a hard conversation with their leadership.
Comfort deciding with incomplete information and owning the outcome.
Experience building structure where none existed, in an environment where most of the work is still bespoke.
Willingness to balance one customer's urgency against what scales across the portfolio.

Experience With Robotics Or IoT Is Not Required.

The salary for this role is between $225,000 - $275,000 /year.

Full-time Benefits

Viam's base salary range for this role is posted above. In addition to cash compensation, Viam offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants, health benefits, and more.

100% covered medical/dental/vision insurance plans, commuter benefits
25 days paid vacation and generous holiday observances
Free lunch every day that you're in the office
One Medical Membership
Citi Bike memberships
Monthly wellness stipend to be used for a variety of fitness-related items like gym memberships, fitness classes, fitness equipment, and more
Paid parental leave
Reproductive Health Benefits, including Fertility Benefits and Abortion Access Travel Benefits
Yearly Learning and Development Budget for your own personal learning goals

Values:

Vision Driven
Collaborate Openly
Act Decisively
Succeed Through Diversity
Hold Ourselves Accountable
Lead with Curiosity

In this role, you will shape the test strategy, quality standards, and execution model for intelligent systems that power the next generation of connected, autonomous, and software-defined machines. This leader will guide cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges, build AI tools that improve software testing products, advance modern test automation and AI-enabled quality practices, and ensure Caterpillar delivers safe, reliable, and scalable technology for customers working in the world’s most demanding environments.

jobs.description:
Job Summary 

The Director of Infrastructure is responsible for the strategic direction, architecture, management, and continuous improvement of Farmers & Merchants Bank's enterprise infrastructure and technology operations. Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, this role oversees networks, cloud platforms, data centers, workplace technologies, and infrastructure service delivery to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable technology services that support business objectives, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance. The Director establishes infrastructure standards, service levels, performance metrics, and long-term technology roadmaps while leading infrastructure modernization and operational efficiency initiatives. 

This position develops long-term infrastructure roadmaps and architectures, establishes service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, resiliency, security, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

Develops and executes the Bank's enterprise infrastructure strategy, architecture roadmap, and technology standards.

Defines long-term infrastructure plans that support business growth, operational scalability, regulatory requirements, and technology modernization initiatives.

Evaluates emerging technologies, industry trends, and leading practices to improve infrastructure capabilities and service delivery.

Leads infrastructure transformation initiatives, including cloud adoption, automation, platform modernization, and lifecycle management.

Enterprise Infrastructure Management

Provides leadership and oversight for enterprise infrastructure including networks, cloud services, servers, storage, virtualization platforms, telecommunications, data center technologies, and workplace technologies.

Ensures infrastructure solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with business and technology objectives.

Oversee infrastructure design, engineering, implementation, maintenance, and operational support activities.

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

Establishes infrastructure service delivery standards and operational procedures.

Defines and monitors service level agreements (SLAs), operational level agreements (OLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and service metrics.

Identifies opportunities to improve service quality, customer experience, operational efficiency, and infrastructure performance.

Ensures the availability, reliability, and performance of critical technology platforms and services.

Security, Risk & Compliance

Partners with Information Security to implement infrastructure security controls, monitoring, vulnerability management, patch management, identity management, and secure configuration standards.

Supports compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, security standards, audit requirements, and Bank policies.

Participate in technology risk assessments, audits, regulatory examinations, and remediation activities.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

Oversees business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for infrastructure systems and services.

Ensure recovery solutions meet organizational resilience objectives.

Directs disaster recovery testing, infrastructure recovery planning, and operational resiliency initiatives.

Vendor & Financial Management

Manages infrastructure-related vendors, service providers, contracts, licensing agreements, and technology partners.

Develops and manages infrastructure operating and capital budgets.

Identifies cost optimization opportunities while maintaining service quality and performance standards.

Oversees procurement, vendor performance reviews, and contract negotiations.

Leadership & Talent Development

Leads, mentors, and develops infrastructure engineering and operations teams.

Establishes departmental goals, performance expectations, and development plans.

Promotes a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Supports succession planning and workforce development initiatives.

Governance & Executive Reporting

Serves as a strategic advisor to the Chief Technology Officer regarding infrastructure investments, operational risks, service performance, and technology priorities.

Provides executive reporting on infrastructure health, service delivery performance, strategic initiatives, project status, and operational risks.

Establishes governance processes that promote service quality, operational transparency, and infrastructure maturity.

Compliance Responsibilities

Complies with all applicable state and federal banking laws, regulations, and internal policies related but not limited to lending, operations, and deposit requirements, including Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) regulations, Customer Identification Program (CIP) requirements, Financial Elder Abuse reporting laws, Sexual Harassment prevention policies, information security and privacy requirements.

Required Knowledge 

Enterprise infrastructure architecture, engineering, operations, and support practices.

Cloud platforms, networking, storage, virtualization, endpoint technologies, and data center technologies.

IT service management principles and leading practices, including service delivery frameworks such as ITIL.

Disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational resiliency principles.

Cybersecurity, risk management, vulnerability management, and infrastructure security controls.

Vendor management, budgeting, technology governance, and project delivery methodologies.

Banking industry technology operations and regulatory requirements.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Strong leadership and strategic planning capabilities.

Ability to develop enterprise technology roadmaps and infrastructure strategies.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to executive leadership and business stakeholders.

Strong vendor management, contract negotiation, and financial management skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and highly regulated environment.

Demonstrated ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing teams.

Ability to balance business needs, operational efficiency, security requirements, and risk mitigation.

Equipment Operated 

Operates standard electronic computers and customary office equipment required to perform essential job functions.

Use of equipment is required, with or without reasonable accommodation, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA).

  Physical Requirements & Work Environment 

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Nothing in this description is intended to limit the availability of reasonable accommodation under applicable law.

Ability to perform repetitive movements associated with office and computer-based work.

Ability to sit and or stand for extended periods of time to perform essential job functions.

Ability to lift, carry, or move objects weighing up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Ability to use hands and fingers to manage, manipulate, or feel objects and operate standard office equipment.

Work is primarily performed in an office environment with a controlled temperature and standard office conditions.

Education and Experience 

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum of ten (10) years of progressive infrastructure, engineering, or technology operations experience.

Minimum of five (5) years of leadership experience managing technology teams and enterprise infrastructure environments.

Experience within banking, financial services, or another highly regulated industry preferred.

Experience with hybrid cloud environments, infrastructure modernization, disaster recovery, cybersecurity, and vendor management preferred.

Relevant certifications such as ITIL, CISSP, CISM, Azure, AWS, CCNP, or PMP preferred.

Minimum Absence Requirement

Some positions within the Bank have been designated as sensitive positions due to access to critical systems, records, or processes. In accordance with Bank policy and sound internal‑control practices, employees in sensitive positions are required to complete a mandatory consecutive absence from essential duties each calendar year to support segregation of duties and independent review.

The required absence will be scheduled in coordination with management to ensure continuity of operations. Administration of absence, including paid or unpaid status, will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local wage and hour and leave laws, including California requirements.

Required Minimum Absence for This Position: (2) Consecutive Weeks

For qualified positions, the Bank may designate an Officer Title based on the role’s job level, scope of responsibility, and alignment with established competency frameworks. Eligibility for an Officer Title designation is contingent upon the employee meeting defined competency, performance, and experience requirements and is governed by applicable Bank policies, governance standards, and required approval processes.

This position is eligible for the following Officer Title(s): First Vice President

Compensation

The listed range represents the full compensation range for this position. Placement within the range will be determined based on factors including skills, relevant experience, job‑related qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity, in accordance with Bank compensation policies.

Exempt Salary Range: $176,540 – $327,860 per year

Employees may be required to perform other duties as assigned, consistent with business needs and applicable law.

Farmers and Merchants Bank of Long Beach reserve the right to modify, amend, or discontinue job duties or requirements at any time. Nothing in this job description creates a contract of employment, either express or implied, or alters the at‑will nature of employment.

jobs.title: Deputy Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Summary

The Deputy Director of Engineering (DDOE)
is responsible for planning, prioritizing, communi-cating, and executing the engineering work efforts across Trident Research to ensure engineer-ing products and services are delivered on time and within scope. The DDOE works under the oversight of the Director of Engineering (DOE) to manage engineering tasking across multiple disciplines, including Mechanical, Electrical, Software, and Systems, as well as aerospace and materials engineering where applicable, ensuring on-time and on-budget completion of R&D-focused work that prioritizes high-quality, practical solutions over perfection. The greatest resource at Trident Research is our engineering talent, and the DDOE is the frontline manager of this multidisciplinary team. It is, therefore, critical to mentor and coach each team member to achieve individual and team success. The DDOE fosters a healthy, trusting, and growth-ori-ented environment through direct engagement with engineers, aligning with the DOE’s vision for a cohesive engineering team. We recognize our work is R&D in nature in many cases and per-fection is never the goal. To build a healthy team, development of a trusting and growth-oriented environment through engagement with the engineers is key. 

DDOE works closely with the Director of Engineering (DOE) to proactively search for, review, and ultimately recommend new technologies, tools, equipment, and other engineering resources that are ‘right for Trident’ and are reasonable (e.g., business case is sound). The DDOE collaborates with the DOE and the Head of Technology and Research (HTR) to identify and resolve technically challenging aspects of the work and recommend technology investments. While it is the responsibility of the DOE to submit and coordinate with the Executive Team to ensure needs are budgeted and executed accordingly, the DDOE does serve as the eyes and ears for the engineers on the floor to make sure we’re properly resourced to complete the work. 

The DDOE will participate in the full cycle of engineering development, from identifying, recruiting, and training talent through overseeing and engaging on engineering design reviews, to rep-resenting Trident Research in presenting developed solutions and product results to our customers. The DDOE supports the DOE in all phases of the engineering development cycle, ensuring alignment with the DOE’s vision and corporate objectives. A principal goal of the DDOE is the appropriate execution of the Systems Engineering Process (SEP) for the work to be accomplished for the company. The DDOE implements the SEP under DOE oversight, ensuring the use of agile development methodologies to support rapid prototyping and iterative development of minimum viable products. Sound engineering principles are required of all engineers if the team is to be successful, and the DDOE's greatest influence in this regard is the company SEP. 

The DDOE works in partnership with the Program Management Office (PMO). Our Project Man-agers (PMs) are responsible for supervising projects, staying on budget, and are directly accountable to our customers. The DDOE and PMs work together to ensure that Trident tracks and delivers exceptional engineering products and services that meet or exceed customer expectations and contractual requirements. The DDOE coordinates with PMs to resolve programmatic conflicts, communicate delays, and ensure technical excellence in contracted efforts, un-der DOE oversight. It is expected that the DDOE will expend approximately half of their time directly engaged on helping to lead, refine, and ensure technical excellence across all contracted work. 

 Success in this position will require proactive communication (i.e., delays, issues, JIRA tasking, etc.). The DDOE must be a strategic thinker and problem solver, possess outstanding technical engineering skills (particularly with regards to risk management), demonstrate excellent written and oral communications skills when representing the company, and be self-motivated to engage and lead. The DDOE ensures engineering processes are effective and efficient, contributing to the DOE’s vision of intuitive and adaptable processes.

 The DDOE must also have prior experience and demonstrated expertise in conducting research and leading technical teams, technical staff supervision, coaching and mentoring, conflict resolution and career mentoring in a rapid-paced research and development environment. The DDOE helps define positional responsibilities and metrics for engineers with the DOE. The met-rics should roll up into department KRAs and KPIs that are ultimately approved by the president. 

Requirements

Educational and Experience Requirements:

●      Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Required, a Master of Science or doctorate degree in engineering or related field preferred
●      5 years minimum engineering experience
●      Proven track record of leading world-class engineers in multiple disciples.
●      Experience setting and meeting budget/time goals for project tasking utilizing JIRA .
●      Command leadership skills demonstrating sound judgement and personal accountability, with a commitment to excellence, commitment to mission, and commitment to the team.
●      Excellence in Microsoft Office, Project, and SharePoint products, and Jira required.
●      Experience providing written and oral presentations to internal and external customers.
●      Experience in integrating AI, machine learning (ML), and data analytics into engineering solutions, ensuring robust, secure, and optimized models for edge deployment. 
●      Experience in exploring new technologies and methodologies for military applications, ensuring systems are modular, scalable, and adaptable to evolving threats. 

Other Requirements:

●      Must obtain and maintain a minimum of a Secret Security Clearance
●      Must obtain and maintain a valid passport
●      Occasionally exposed to disagreeable conditions. May work extended hours or weekends. May travel overnight or on weekends.

Key Responsibilities
Engineering Team Leadership 50% 1.   Provide effective day-to-day programmatic resource allocation to the engineering team such that all engineering team members are performing optimally.
2.   Provide consistent and frequent feedback to employees by conducting 1-on-1 meetings with direct reports at least biweekly (travel permitting). These sessions are meant to provide mentoring and coaching on work products as well as engagement on work satisfaction, growth opportunities and personal connection within the team.
3.   Provide at least one threads comment per direct report per month.
4.   Identify training plan and career growth track for each direct report semi-annually.
5.   Maintain a record of your team’s skill. Update at least semi-annually.
6.   Monitor and update job descriptions semi-annually for your team members as necessary so that the appropriate duties and responsibilities are captured. This should be done in advance of performance reviews.
7.   Consistently issue and monitor work tasking so that each team member has ample direction and work for a two week time period. Adjustments to priorities can be made, but we must ensure that all team members are engaged.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (Network Value + Outcomes)
jobs.description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.
We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

Senior Engineering Manager, Payer & Outcomes

Headway's mission is a big one – to build a new mental health care system everyone can access. We've built technology that helps people find great therapists with the first software-enabled national network of providers accepting insurance.

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but the majority of providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway is building a new mental healthcare system that everyone can access by making it easy for therapists to accept insurance and scale their practice.

Headway was founded in 2019. Since then, we've grown into a diverse, national network of over 60,000 mental healthcare providers across all 50 states who run their practice on our software and have served over 1 million patients. We're a Series D company with over $325m in funding from a16z (Andreessen Horowitz), Accel, GV (formerly Google Ventures), Spark Capital, Thrive Capital, Forerunner Ventures and Health Care Service Corporation.

We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About Engineering At Headway

Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. The engineering team at Headway is a small but mighty team using technology to build that future (and have a fun time while doing it!).

Principles That Guide Us

Focus on the mission: We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapists to better solve the problems they're facing.
Ship small, learn fast: We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iterating.
Everything is a product: Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we treat everything we build at Headway as a product with end-users in mind.
Optimize for trust: We believe that engineers should be continually learning. To learn effectively and to be productive, engineers must feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes.

Tools We Use

Languages: Python 3, TypeScript
Libraries & Frameworks: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React, Remix, Next.js
Datastores: Postgres, Redis
Infrastructure: AWS (Fargate, ECS, S3, SageMaker and more), Spark and Kafka
Monitoring: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry
Version Control: Github
Vulnerability Management: Snyk, Semgrep
Cloud Security: Lacework

About This Role

Headway's mission is to build a new mental healthcare system that everyone can access, one that works for patients, providers, and payers alike. Our Payer & Outcomes group is where we prove that model works. We build the systems that answer two questions insurers have never been able to answer well: did the care actually work, and was it worth it?

As Senior Engineering Manager for Payer & Outcomes, you'll lead the two teams that answer them. Outcomes builds our measurement backbone: collecting patient-reported outcomes at scale, tracking symptom improvement and retention to care, and turning that into evidence we can stand behind. Network Value builds the intelligence behind utilization and cost of care, covering patient acuity and segmentation, provider efficiency ranking, and the sub-network logic that routes a patient to the right level of care.

These two teams share data foundations, a measurement stack, and an audience, which is why they sit together under one leader. You'll own delivery on a company-level goal we have publicly committed to: significantly increasing the share of new patients with a baseline outcome measure, without increasing provider churn. That means holding quality and adoption in tension rather than trading one for the other.

You'll grow and mentor a team of roughly eight engineers plus an engineering manager, set the technical and operational roadmap across both pods, and partner daily with Product, Clinical, Data Science, and our payer-facing commercial teams. This is a deeply cross-functional role: your work is what lets Headway move payers from administrative oversight to genuine care partnership.

The stakes here are concrete. Elsewhere in the group we now review clinical notes and prompt providers to put a safety plan in place when a patient shows signs of suicidal risk. At full adoption across our network, that single intervention is estimated to prevent more than 1,000 deaths a year. Your teams build the measurement and targeting layer that decides where interventions like that get aimed, and whether we can prove they worked.

Who You Are

We're looking for an experienced engineering leader who is product-minded, data-informed, and energized by growth. You'll work closely with Engineering Leadership, Product, and Data to shape the future of Headway's payer strategy. There is an unusually direct line from your team's work to whether this model of care survives contact with the market.

In this role you will

Lead, manage, and grow two engineering teams
Own delivery on a company-level outcomes key result, including its guardrails
Set the technical and operational roadmap across measurement, segmentation, and utilization
Develop your team through weekly 1:1s, mentorship, and direct feedback, and develop the manager reporting to you
Partner closely with Product, Clinical, Data Science, and Commercial to iterate quickly and rigorously
Contribute to the broader group and company strategy, not just your own roadmap

Experience We're Seeking

6+ years of engineering management experience at a high-growth startup or scale-up, including managing managers or tech leads
3–5+ years of experience as a software engineer, enough to hold technical direction credibly
A track record of building and leading high-performing teams that delivered business outcomes through technical investment
A strong product mindset and cross-functional relationships that build trust with users and stakeholders
Experience owning an externally-committed metric, with the scope discipline that requires
Comfort with data- and ML-heavy systems: measurement, experimentation, and metric guardrails
Nice to have: healthcare, insurance, or another regulated, high-trust domain
Nice to have: value-based care, quality measurement, or utilization management
Nice to have: prior experience with Python, React, and AWS infrastructure

You'll love this role if you want to

Lead the teams that decide whether a new model of mental healthcare can be proven, not just described
Own a number the company reports externally, with the autonomy that comes with it
Build an engineering management layer beneath you rather than inherit a finished org

Our interview process

After you apply to Headway, here are some details of what to expect during the interview process.

Initial screen: You'll connect with someone in recruiting so you can learn more about the team, Headway's mission and exciting growth, and we can get a better idea of your background.
First rounds: You'll meet with an engineering leader on the team to go deeper into your team and people leadership experience. You'll also complete an AI Coding round — a collaborative session where we're less focused on syntax and more on how you think through problems and work with AI tools in a technical context.
Final rounds: You'll meet team members across product and engineering leadership for multiple behavioral interviews and one more technical interview (System Design), leaving you with a fuller picture of what it's like to work at Headway.
References and the Offer: Our favorite part of the process! We'll send over all of the details, including specifics on employee equity, and congratulatory messages from excited future team members!

Compensation And Benefits

The expected base pay range for this position is $265,200 - 331,500, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for performance-based variable compensation and an equity grant, depending on the position and level.

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

Benefits Offered Include

Job Description Summary

Breakthru Beverage Group (BBG) is in the midst of a major enterprise transformation to modernize our technology landscape, simplify enterprise integrations, and enable AI-driven capabilities across the business. As part of this transformation, we are building a modern, cloud-native technology ecosystem powered by SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake, AWS, and next-generation AI capabilities. A critical pillar of this strategy is establishing a secure, scalable integration platform that seamlessly connects enterprise applications, data platforms, trading partners, and AI agents.

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on technology leader to define and execute BBG's enterprise integration strategy while establishing the architecture, engineering standards, and governance that will serve as the digital backbone of the organization.

The Director, Enterprise Integration, EDI & AI Agent Platform will lead the teams responsible for enterprise application integration, APIs, event-driven architecture, EDI, managed file transfer, and AI agent integration. This leader will partner closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data Engineering, Data Governance, and the AI Center of Excellence to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable integration capabilities that accelerate BBG's digital transformation and enable next-generation intelligent automation.

Job Description

This role follows a flexible hybrid schedule, with two days per week in the office and three days working from home. This role can be performed from any Breakthru Beverage Office Location.

Job Responsibilities

Strategy, Architecture & Governance:
Enterprise Integration Strategy: Execute the enterprise integration strategy and approved roadmap established by Data & AI leadership, Enterprise Architecture, and the VP to support secure, scalable, API-first, and event-driven connectivity across the organization.
Implement Integration Standards and Governance: Maintain and ensure adherence to approved architectural principles, integration patterns, security requirements, development standards, and governance practices across the integration environment.
Enable AI Agent Integration & Governance: Partner with teams to implement approved integration patterns and controls that enable AI agents to securely interact with enterprise systems, APIs, and governed data.

Integration Delivery, Operations & Transformation:
Lead Integration, Platform Delivery & Operations: Direct the design, implementation, operation, and optimization of enterprise integrations, APIs, event-streaming, managed file-transfer, and EDI capabilities connecting SAP, Snowflake, Salesforce, Workday, Microsoft 365, customers, suppliers, and other enterprise platforms.
Deliver Transformation Initiatives: Lead the execution of integration workstreams supporting cloud, ERP, dta, AI, and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring delivery against approved scope, timelines, budgets, and business outcomes.
Drive Operational Excellence: Ensure highly available, secure, and resilient integration services through robust monitoring, SLA management, incident response, automation, security, and continuous improvement.

Leadership, Talent & Partner Management:
Build and Lead a High-Performing Organization: Recruit, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of integration engineers, architects, and EDI specialists while managing strategic technology partners and fostering a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and accountability.

Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder's supervisor, may also be required.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years of experience in large scale enterprise integration, middleware, API, platform engineering, or integration architecture initiatives, including at least 5 years in leadership roles.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Customer Deployments and Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
Who we are

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.

TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.

We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.

We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!

About The Role

With our Series B, we are entering our next chapter: building a full-stack video AI company with frontier models at the foundation, an enterprise platform in the middle, and agentic systems that turn raw video into actionable knowledge and insights.

Our customers include some of the world’s leading companies across media, sports, advertising, security, and the public sector. They are asking us to solve increasingly complex problems—not only through our APIs, but by deploying TwelveLabs technology securely and reliably into their environments.

As Director of Engineering, Deployment & Integrations, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for deploying TwelveLabs technology into our customers' and partners’ environments and integrating it deeply into their existing technology ecosystems.

You will own the engineering strategy and execution for customer and distribution partner deployments across hyperscalers, private cloud, on-premise, and other complex enterprise environments. You will work closely with our Engineering and Go to Market teams to turn complex customer requirements into scalable, repeatable deployment and integration capabilities.

This is a highly cross-functional and customer-facing engineering leadership role. You will be equally comfortable working through architecture with a customer's technical team, diving into a complex deployment or integration challenge, and building the systems and processes that allow the next customer to move faster.

Your goal is to make TwelveLabs easy to deploy, easy to integrate, and reliable to operate — while turning the lessons from each customer into capabilities that scale across the business.

In this role, you will focus on the core competencies listed below

Customer Deployment

Own the engineering lifecycle for customer and partner deployments, from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, production launch, and ongoing operations.
Lead deployments across public cloud, customer VPCs, private cloud, on-premise infrastructure, and other customer-controlled environments.
Partner directly with strategic customers, partners and their engineering, infrastructure, security, and IT teams to solve complex deployment challenges.
Establish the technical standards, tooling, and playbooks required to make deployments predictable and repeatable.
Turn recurring customer deployment requirements into scalable product and platform capabilities wherever possible.

Integrations & Enterprise Architecture

Own the engineering strategy for integrating TwelveLabs into customers' existing technology ecosystems.
Build scalable integration patterns across enterprise applications, data platforms, storage systems, identity and access management, APIs, and AI/ML infrastructure.
Partner with Product and Engineering to translate recurring customer integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
Establish standards and tooling that make integrations faster, more reliable, and increasingly self-service.
Balance customer-specific requirements with a long-term architecture that prevents TwelveLabs from accumulating one-off integrations.
Help define the technical architecture and interfaces that allow TwelveLabs to become deeply embedded in customer workflows and applications.

Deployment Automation & Developer Experience

Build the tooling, automation, and internal platforms that allow engineering teams to provision, configure, upgrade, integrate, and operate customer environments efficiently.
Develop deployment and integration architectures that move TwelveLabs from bespoke implementations toward repeatable, highly automated capabilities.
Establish strong CI/CD, release management, configuration management, and observability practices for distributed customer environments.
Create an exceptional internal developer experience for engineers responsible for building and supporting deployments and integrations.

Product & Engineering Partnership

Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure deployment and integration requirements are incorporated into product architecture from the beginning.
Identify recurring friction across customer deployments and integrations and turn those insights into product and platform improvements.
Partner with Research and ML teams to understand the operational requirements of serving increasingly capable multimodal models in production environments.
Help define the technical roadmap for deployment and integration infrastructure as TwelveLabs expands its product portfolio and customer footprint.

Customer, Partnerships & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a senior technical partner to Solutions Engineering, Sales, and Product on the most complex customer opportunities.
Translate customer requirements into clear technical decisions, engineering priorities, and execution plans.
Establish a strong operating rhythm across customer-facing and engineering teams to ensure deployments and integrations move quickly without compromising quality.
Communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly to both highly technical audiences and executive stakeholders.

Security, Compliance & Trust

Build deployment and integration architectures suitable for enterprise and public sector customers with demanding security and compliance requirements.
Partner with Security and Infrastructure teams to support requirements around data isolation, identity, access control, encryption, auditability, and compliance.
Help establish deployment patterns capable of supporting increasingly regulated and security-sensitive environments.

Team Building & Culture

Build and lead a world-class Deployment & Integrations Engineering organization.
Recruit, develop, and retain engineers who thrive at the intersection of distributed systems, infrastructure, product engineering, enterprise integrations, and customer problem-solving.
Create a culture of high ownership, technical excellence, urgency, and disciplined execution.
Establish the processes and operating mechanisms that allow the team to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for reliability and customer experience.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

10+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, platform engineering, or distributed systems, with significant experience leading globally distributed engineering teams.
Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for deploying complex software, AI/ML systems, or infrastructure into enterprise customer environments.
Deep technical understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployment systems.
Experience deploying software across multiple cloud environments and/or customer-controlled infrastructure, including air-gapped, disconnected, regulated, or highly secure environments
Hands-on experience owning the software deployment lifecycle end-to-end — versioning, release management, rollout + rollback strategy, upgrade paths, and post-deployment operations across distributed customer environments.
Deep experience with software packaging patterns for shipping into customer-controlled environments — container images, Helm charts, operator patterns, installer + bootstrap flows, air-gapped bundles, and dependency + configuration management.
A track record of turning bespoke customer implementations into scalable, repeatable engineering systems.
Strong customer-facing instincts and the ability to operate credibly with senior engineers, architects, security teams, and technical executives at large enterprises.
A bias toward action and a willingness to get into the technical details when the situation demands it.
Excellent judgment about when to build a one-off solution for a strategic customer versus investing in a scalable platform capability.
Experience operating in a high-growth startup where product requirements and customer needs evolve rapidly.
Experience working with globally distributed teams

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience deploying AI/ML or GPU-intensive workloads into customer environments.
Experience with public sector, defense, financial services, or other highly regulated customers.
Experience taking an enterprise deployment motion from bespoke implementations to a standardized platform.
Experience building or leading Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Deployment Engineering, or Professional Services Engineering organizations.

jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

Pragmatic Optimism

Excellence without Ego

Proactive Collaboration

Job Overview
Mainspring Energy’s revolutionary linear generator is a sophisticated robot. Inside the generator is a network of computers combining embedded Linux and real-time bare metal applications. These orchestrate the critical tasks of shaping control signals and collecting data from a wide variety of sensors which make this technology possible. Our embedded platform is rapidly evolving, and we need great managers to lead the engineering team making it happen. If you love leading people to solve challenging technological problems and are passionate about driving an efficient, agile process, then we need you!

Responsibilities

This is a managing role for an embedded software team. 

As a leader in the organization you will:

Strategic Leadership:
Define the long-term technical roadmap and align engineering deliverables with overarching business goals

Team Leadership:
Supervise, mentor, and guide a team of software engineers, conducting regular one-on-ones and performance reviews

Project Management:
Oversee the full software development lifecycle, setting clear milestones, managing timelines, and removing roadblocks

Process and Architecture:
Drive engineering excellence by defining org-wide standards for code quality, architectural governance, and system reliability

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with product managers, executives, and QA teams to align technical goals with business needs

Technical Guidance:
Provide high-level architectural and technical feedback during design reviews

Hiring and Growth:
Interview, hire, and onboard new engineering talent while building paths for career growth within the team

Qualifications

You have...

Experience:
15+ years embedded software development experience (real-time a plus) including 4+ years of people management, and project management experience delivering multiple commercial products

Methodologies:
Strong background in Agile, Scrum, or Kanban project management frameworks

Strong stakeholder management skills to negotiate priorities with executives, product VPs, and external partners

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Experience Foundations - Confluent
jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

We're seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to join our Experience Foundations team. This team owns critical TEAR (Trusted Experiences Access & Revenue) domains including Security UI, Networking UI, and Billing UI, as well as the shared experience foundations infrastructure (formerly UIF/UI Foundations team).

You'll lead the evolution of our foundations infrastructure from UI-only support to serving the entire Experience organization which includes several other interfaces (API/CLI/TF/VSCode/MCP). Along with this you will help establish patterns and best practices that enable UI engineers to confidently develop security and networking features across our application portfolio—including Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, and Tableflow.

In this role, you'll also support the evolution of Networking, Security, and Billing UI experiences, especially as we adopt and integrate the latest and greatest technologies in these domains. As cloud providers introduce new networking capabilities, security standards evolve, and billing models become more sophisticated, you'll ensure our UI stays at the forefront—providing intuitive, scalable interfaces that make complex technical capabilities accessible to our customers.

The Experience Foundations Team Owns Several Critical Pillars

Security: User authentication, authorization, and security experiences (RBAC, BYOK, SSO, API keys, encryption management)
Networking: Network configuration and connectivity interfaces (private networking, VPC peering, PrivateLink across AWS, GCP, Azure)
Billing UI: Revenue-critical billing and payment experiences (subscription models, multi-month commits, promotional offers, chargebacks, usage tracking
Experience Foundations Infrastructure: Shared UI/UX infrastructure and tooling (formerly UIF/UI Foundations), this includes our design system, compliance support, experience performance, accessibility and more.

These capabilities sit at the intersection of trust, infrastructure control, and revenue generation—foundational pillars that support our entire application ecosystem across Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products.

What You Will Do:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Establish clear, reusable patterns and best practices for UI engineers developing security and networking code
Elevate the impact of all UI engineers across multiple product teams (Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow)
Take a depth-first, hands-on approach to understanding systems and unblocking teams
Go deep in domain areas—understand the technical intricacies of networking protocols, security models, and billing systems to make sound architectural decisions
Drive the evolution of Experience Foundations infrastructure from UI-only to supporting the entire Experience organization, partner with the existing Engineering Manager to shape and execute the foundations roadmap

Cross-Functional Partnership

Own PM and Design partnerships for Security, Networking, and Billing domains
Ensure smooth execution and delivery of product initiatives across these verticals
Bridge technical and product perspectives to drive aligned outcomes
Translate domain complexity into clear execution plans
Challenge product specs when necessary to ensure technical feasibility
Partner with product teams across the portfolio to ensure patterns meet their needs
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs transparently to senior leadership

Team & People Management

Collaborate with existing engineering leadership to build cohesive team strategy, including existing manager in the foundations space as your direct report
Mentor and develop engineers across multiple disciplines and experience levels
Foster a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Create leverage by empowering engineers with patterns, tools, and knowledge
Build strong connections between Experience Foundations and application teams
Champion developer productivity through AI tooling adoption, test automation, and improved engineering processes

Your work will enable UX engineers across our entire application portfolio to build consistent, high-quality security and networking experiences. By establishing clear patterns and evolving our foundations infrastructure, you'll multiply the impact of every engineer working on Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products—while supporting the foundational pillars that drive over 70% of Confluent's revenue.

If you're energized by the challenge of transforming foundations infrastructure while elevating engineering capabilities across critical product domains, we'd love to talk.

Preferred Education

None

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
Strong hands-on technical background with ability to dive deep into complex systems
Deep frontend engineering expertise: Strong understanding of modern web development (React, TypeScript, component design systems)
Proven ability to distill complex technical domains into clear patterns and best practices
Experience creating reusable patterns/frameworks adopted across multiple teams or products
Track record of elevating team capabilities through mentorship and knowledge sharing
Demonstrated success partnering with Product and Design to drive execution
Experience managing or collaborating closely with other engineering managers
Experience managing multiple product areas or technical domains simultaneously

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience managing managers or leading leaders

jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

We're seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to join our Experience Foundations team. This team owns critical TEAR (Trusted Experiences Access & Revenue) domains including Security UI, Networking UI, and Billing UI, as well as the shared experience foundations infrastructure (formerly UIF/UI Foundations team).

You'll lead the evolution of our foundations infrastructure from UI-only support to serving the entire Experience organization which includes several other interfaces (API/CLI/TF/VSCode/MCP). Along with this you will help establish patterns and best practices that enable UI engineers to confidently develop security and networking features across our application portfolio—including Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, and Tableflow.

In this role, you'll also support the evolution of Networking, Security, and Billing UI experiences, especially as we adopt and integrate the latest and greatest technologies in these domains. As cloud providers introduce new networking capabilities, security standards evolve, and billing models become more sophisticated, you'll ensure our UI stays at the forefront—providing intuitive, scalable interfaces that make complex technical capabilities accessible to our customers.

The Experience Foundations Team Owns Several Critical Pillars

Security: User authentication, authorization, and security experiences (RBAC, BYOK, SSO, API keys, encryption management)
Networking: Network configuration and connectivity interfaces (private networking, VPC peering, PrivateLink across AWS, GCP, Azure)
Billing UI: Revenue-critical billing and payment experiences (subscription models, multi-month commits, promotional offers, chargebacks, usage tracking
Experience Foundations Infrastructure: Shared UI/UX infrastructure and tooling (formerly UIF/UI Foundations), this includes our design system, compliance support, experience performance, accessibility and more.

These capabilities sit at the intersection of trust, infrastructure control, and revenue generation—foundational pillars that support our entire application ecosystem across Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products.

What You Will Do:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Establish clear, reusable patterns and best practices for UI engineers developing security and networking code
Elevate the impact of all UI engineers across multiple product teams (Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow)
Take a depth-first, hands-on approach to understanding systems and unblocking teams
Go deep in domain areas—understand the technical intricacies of networking protocols, security models, and billing systems to make sound architectural decisions
Drive the evolution of Experience Foundations infrastructure from UI-only to supporting the entire Experience organization, partner with the existing Engineering Manager to shape and execute the foundations roadmap

Cross-Functional Partnership

Own PM and Design partnerships for Security, Networking, and Billing domains
Ensure smooth execution and delivery of product initiatives across these verticals
Bridge technical and product perspectives to drive aligned outcomes
Translate domain complexity into clear execution plans
Challenge product specs when necessary to ensure technical feasibility
Partner with product teams across the portfolio to ensure patterns meet their needs
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs transparently to senior leadership

Team & People Management

Collaborate with existing engineering leadership to build cohesive team strategy, including existing manager in the foundations space as your direct report
Mentor and develop engineers across multiple disciplines and experience levels
Foster a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Create leverage by empowering engineers with patterns, tools, and knowledge
Build strong connections between Experience Foundations and application teams
Champion developer productivity through AI tooling adoption, test automation, and improved engineering processes

Your work will enable UX engineers across our entire application portfolio to build consistent, high-quality security and networking experiences. By establishing clear patterns and evolving our foundations infrastructure, you'll multiply the impact of every engineer working on Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products—while supporting the foundational pillars that drive over 70% of Confluent's revenue.

If you're energized by the challenge of transforming foundations infrastructure while elevating engineering capabilities across critical product domains, we'd love to talk.
