new_jobs.title: Director, AI & Engineering Development(Onsite) Overland Park, KS
new_jobs.description:
About Netsmart

Netsmart is a leading healthcare technology organization dedicated to Moving Healthcare Forward, Together. For more than 55 years, Netsmart has partnered with community-based and post-acute care providers to improve outcomes for the individuals and communities they serve. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, trust, service, and a strong commitment to responsible, secure innovation in healthcare.

Role Overview

Netsmart is seeking a Director, AI & Engineering Development to lead engineering execution for AI-enabled solutions across our healthcare technology platform. This leader will help translate product and AI strategy into scalable, secure, reliable solutions that deliver measurable impact for clients and communities.

This role is designed for a leader who has grown up through software engineering and architecture, understands how modern systems are built and operated, and can earn credibility with engineers while partnering effectively across Product, Data, Clinical, Security, Compliance, and business teams.

The Director will provide hands-on technical leadership and people leadership, helping teams operationalize AI capabilities responsibly while maintaining strong engineering standards, delivery discipline, and platform scalability.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & AI Delivery

Lead engineering teams responsible for building, deploying, and operating AI-enabled and data-driven solutions.
Translate AI and product priorities into engineering roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
Drive strong execution across quality, performance, security, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.
Apply modern engineering, DevOps, and MLOps practices to support continuous delivery and production excellence.

Architecture & Technical Leadership

Provide technical leadership across application architecture, AI platforms, data pipelines, integrations, and cloud-based systems.
Guide architectural decisions and engineering tradeoffs with a practical, hands-on understanding of software development.
Establish and uphold engineering standards, reusable patterns, design practices, and code quality expectations.
Promote platform thinking to enable AI capabilities that are scalable, sustainable, maintainable, and reusable across solutions.

Product & Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product Management to deliver AI capabilities aligned to client needs, market priorities, and business outcomes.
Collaborate with Data Science, Analytics, Clinical, Compliance, Privacy, and Security partners to operationalize AI capabilities responsibly.
Communicate technical strategy, delivery progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior technology and product stakeholders.

Responsible AI & Governance

Embed responsible AI practices, including transparency, explainability, monitoring, continuous validation, and human-centered design principles.
Support AI governance, risk management, privacy, security, and compliance efforts in partnership with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Ensure AI solutions align with Netsmart’s commitment to trust, safety, responsible innovation, and community impact.

People Leadership & Operating Discipline

Lead, coach, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Recruit, retain, and grow technical talent aligned with Netsmart values, engineering standards, and delivery expectations.
Create clarity around priorities, decision-making, execution plans, and success measures to help teams operate effectively at scale.

Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience, including leadership roles with increasing scope and accountability.
Strong foundation as a software engineer, technical lead, architect, or engineering leader with demonstrated ability to guide architecture and engineering execution.
Experience delivering AI, machine learning, automation, analytics, or data-driven systems into production environments.
Strong understanding of cloud-based architectures, distributed systems, API/integration patterns, AI/ML platforms, MLOps, DevOps, and modern software delivery practices.
Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization and partner across engineering, product, data, clinical, compliance, security, and business teams.
Experience working in regulated industries; healthcare technology experience strongly preferred.
Strong communication, people leadership, technical judgment, execution discipline, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Experience

Background building or scaling AI-enabled capabilities within enterprise software products.
Experience modernizing engineering practices, improving platform scalability, or establishing reusable architecture patterns.
Demonstrated passion for the future of AI in healthcare technology and the ability to balance innovation with responsible implementation.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted engineering and AI leader who can turn strategy into practical execution. You will help teams build production-ready AI capabilities, strengthen engineering discipline, and deliver scalable solutions that advance Netsmart’s healthcare technology platform.

You will be known for operating with technical credibility, driving delivery clarity, developing strong engineering talent, and partnering across the organization to bring responsible AI innovation to life for clients, clinicians, providers, and communities.

Why Netsmart

At Netsmart, you will build technology that truly matters. This role offers the opportunity to lead impactful AI and engineering development work within a mission-driven organization where innovation supports clinicians, providers, and communities every day.

Netsmart is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all associates. All employment decisions at Netsmart, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion and transfer, are based on performance, qualifications, abilities, education and experience. Netsmart does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, past or present military service, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

Pursuant to Netsmart policy, all post-offer candidates are required to successfully complete a pre-employment background check, including a drug screen, which is provided at Netsmart’s sole expense. In the event a candidate tests positive for a controlled substance, Netsmart will rescind the offer of employment unless the individual can provide proof of valid prescription to Netsmart’s third party screening provider.

Description

Seven Seas Water Group

Seven Seas Water Group (www.sevenseaswater.com) is a portfolio company owned by investment funds managed by EQT. Headquartered in Tampa, with operations across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America, Seven Seas Water Group (SSWG) delivers annually over 20 billion gallons of water to industrial, commercial, governmental, municipal, and hospitality customers. SSWG designs, builds, owns, and operates, delivers new facilities, or acquires and upgrades existing facilities, with the goal of optimizing project risk transfer between the public and private sectors. We have more than 200 water and wastewater treatment plants in operations throughout the United States, Caribbean, and Latin America. With an outstanding reputation for decentralized water and wastewater treatment solutions, the SSWG “Water-as-a-Service®” approach seeks to help solve global water and wastewater infrastructure challenges.

SSWG operates two businesses within the water infrastructure space. Seven Seas Water, which provides water treatment and desalination for governmental, hospitality and industrial customers in United States, Latin America and the Caribbean, and the AUC Group (www.aucgroup.net), which provides decentralized water and wastewater treatment plants for industrial and municipal customers in the United States.

EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of more than three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors, and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR 273 billion in total assets under management (EUR 141 billion in fee-generating assets under management) as of 30 June 2025, within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.

With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does.

The EQT AB Group comprises EQT AB (publ) and its direct and indirect subsidiaries, which include general partners and fund managers of EQT funds as well as entities advising EQT funds. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.

Seven Seas Water Group is a portfolio company of EQT AB (together with its subsidiaries, "EQT"), a purpose-driven global investment organization that partners with companies worldwide through its Private Capital and Real Assets strategies. Founded in 1994, EQT is a leading active ownership firm that has more than EUR 273 billion in total assets under management across nearly 50 active funds. EQT is committed to investing behind essential infrastructure, partnering with established platforms that deliver sustainable, mission critical services aligned with global needs for resource efficiency.

More info: www.eqtgroup.com

Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering and Design
is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the Engineering department across multiple engineering disciplines focused on water and wastewater applications. This includes design, estimating, and bid proposal work. This role works a hybrid schedule Tues-Thursday in the office, and remotely on M/F.

Requirements

Job Responsibilities:

Support EHS efforts to achieve overall business safety objectives.
Manage the engineering and design teams to effectively design and produce project drawings and documentation for the delivery of water and wastewater plants.
Prioritize workload based on company goals and priorities. Day-to-day management and assignments working with Project Managers and other stakeholders.
Support business development activities by consulting with customers and customers’ technical advisors, as well as preparing preliminary cost estimates and designs.
Serve as a technical resource for business development activities across Texas and other parts of the Country and internationally depending on the company’s needs.
Ensure that all work products are of the highest quality and are on time
Manage QA/QC within the engineering department to minimize project rework.
Work with the Project Management and Construction Management teams to improve and standardize designs to facilitate more effective and streamlined plant construction.
Maintain a healthy work culture of performance, transparency, respect, and trust
Facilitate discussion, decision making, and conflict resolution
Assisting with internal and external communication, improving transparency, and sharing information
Provide all support to the team using a servant leadership style whenever possible, and leading by example
Assess engineering and design tools to ensure the most effective tools are utilized to delivery project materials
Cross-organizational support including marketing, business development, and finance departments to serve as a technical lead

Required Skills

Working Manager – Mentor and garner respect from his/her team. Willing and technically able to jump in and help get the job done
Assertive – Must be able to ensure that company norms are adhered to strictly, document control requirements are met, and all engineering products are checked and approved prior to issuance. Must be able to be a voice of reason and authority, make the tough calls.
Communicative and social – Must be able to communicate well with teams
Facilitative – Must be able to lead and demonstrate value-add principles to a team
Enthusiastic – Must be high-energy
Continuous improvement – Must seize all opportunities to improve the department’s products and processes. Continually be learning new tools and techniques to manage oneself and the team
Conflict resolution – Must be able to facilitate discussion and facilitate alternatives or different approaches
Attitude of transparency – Must embrace transparency both up and down the organization in regards to schedules, performance, and other KPI's related to department performance.
Strong aptitude for planning, organizing, scheduling, assigning and evaluating the work of team.
Ability to train, encourage, and counsel the team.
Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
Expert level of proficiency in computer programs for an engineering office
Expert level of working knowledge of municipal water and wastewater engineering processes.
Strong understanding of other engineering disciplines including:
Mechanical, process, electrical, I&C requirements as well as deep understanding of general water and wastewater plant operations, standard details, scope delineation, and cost estimation
Mastery of the typical document set of documentation required for integration engineering and the sequencing / prerequisites for each, e.g. Mass Balance, PFD’s, P&ID’s, Facility Arrangements, Equipment Arrangements, Network Architecture Diagrams, Valves Lists, Instrument Lists, etc.
Drawing/Document Control including the importance of not having information in multiple locations and revision/change management. Using the drawing/document list and approval status as a measure of progress and performance.

Required Experience

Bachelors Degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field required.

5-10 years experience in an engineering firm or a company specifically working on wastewater projects, or municipal projects.

Professional Engineering (PE) License in the state of Texas or the ability to acquire it within (6) months as a requirement of the job.

Five (5) years experience managing engineers in either a project or a departmental environment.

Experience or Certification as a Project Management Professional (PMP) would be beneficial, but is not required.

Hi, we’re Gravie. Our mission is to create health benefits that actually benefit small and midsize businesses and their employees. Our innovative benefit solutions and services are developed and delivered by a diverse group of unique people. We encourage you to be your authentic self - we like you that way.

About The Role

Gravie is seeking a hands-on, AI-forward Director of Product Engineering to lead our Growth and Offering Enablement pod.

This team builds the products and capabilities that help Gravie win and retain business, improve broker and account-management productivity, shorten the sales lifecycle, and bring new products, networks, and plan designs to market faster.

The pod owns end-to-end product capabilities across this domain and uses the technologies best suited to each problem. Salesforce is a core part of the solution landscape, alongside custom applications, services, integrations, workflow automation, data products, and AI-enabled experiences.

As the engineering leader for this area, you will partner closely with Product Management and leaders across Sales, Account Management, Underwriting, Operations, Data, and Technology.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will remain actively engaged in architecture, technical design, code and configuration reviews, prototyping, and solving complex engineering problems.

You will also help define how engineering is performed in an AI-native organization. We are looking for someone who has moved beyond using AI as a coding copilot and can demonstrate how agentic development has improved the speed, quality, and effectiveness of software delivery.

What You’ll Do

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing product engineering team with expertise across software development, Salesforce, integrations, automation, quality engineering, and cloud technologies.
Partner with Product Management to establish the vision, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for Growth and Offering Enablement.
Own engineering delivery from discovery and technical planning through implementation, release, measurement, and production support.
Set technical direction and make sound architecture and technology decisions across Salesforce, custom software, integrations, automation, and third-party solutions.
Establish modern engineering practices, including source control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, incident management, and incremental delivery.
Improve Salesforce engineering within the domain, including development, configuration, automation, integrations, data, testing, release management, and governance.
Ensure Salesforce configuration and metadata are treated as version-controlled, testable, and reviewable engineering assets while avoiding unnecessary customizations.
Communicate priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering, business, and executive stakeholders.

Drive Agentic Engineering

You will define and advance agentic engineering practices across the software-development lifecycle.

This Includes

Designing agentic workflows that complete bounded, multi-step engineering tasks using approved tools, relevant context, automated validation, and human oversight.
Applying agents to requirements analysis, implementation planning, impact analysis, code and configuration generation, automated testing, code review, documentation, defect investigation, and release validation.
Identifying opportunities to redesign engineering workflows around AI rather than adding AI to inefficient existing processes.
Establishing appropriate controls for data protection, security, permissions, traceability, testing, evaluation, and human approval.
Measuring the effect of AI adoption on delivery speed, quality, cost, developer experience, and operational performance.
Personally demonstrating agentic development through working examples, prototypes, or production workflows.

What You’ll Bring

Significant experience leading product engineering teams responsible for business-critical products, workflows, or customer and employee experiences.
A strong software-engineering background and the technical depth to engage credibly in architecture, design, implementation reviews, debugging, and incident response.
Experience building or materially transforming an engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing technical leaders.
Experience partnering with Product Management and business leaders to translate strategy into roadmaps, technical plans, and measurable outcomes.
Experience delivering capabilities that span custom software, configurable products, APIs, integrations, automation, data, and cloud technologies.
Meaningful experience with Salesforce architecture, development, configuration, automation, integrations, security, data, and release management.
A track record of improving delivery predictability, engineering quality, reliability, and long-term technical health.
Demonstrated experience applying AI across the software development lifecycle, including implementing agentic workflows with appropriate security, evaluation, and human oversight.
Strong technical and product judgment, including the ability to balance speed, complexity, cost, risk, and maintainability.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly to engineers, business leaders, and executives.

Preferred Experience

Healthcare, benefits, insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.
Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Health Cloud, or related technologies.

A Little More About Us

We know healthcare. Our company was founded and is still led by industry veterans who have started and grown several market-leading companies in the space.
We have raised money from top tier investors who share the same long-term vision as we do of building an industry defining company that will endure over the long run. We are well capitalized.
Our clients love us. Customer satisfaction rates among employees using Gravie health plans consistently rank above 80% – nearly 40 points above the industry average.
Our culture is unique. We tend to be non-hierarchical, merit-driven, opinionated but kind people who thrive working in a high-performance, fast-paced environment. People at Gravie care deeply about making a positive impact in the lives of the people we serve.

Benefits

Our unique benefits program is the gravy, i.e., the special sauce that sets our compensation package apart. In addition to standard health and wellness benefits, Gravie’s package includes alternative medicine coverage, flexible PTO, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, paid holidays, a 401k program, transportation perks, education reimbursement, and 2 days of paid paw-ternity leave.

Compensation Range: $180K - $250K

you will lead the department which staffs the design, development, qualification and commissioning of state-of-the-art UV laser optical systems for laser-driven inertial fusion. You will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of optical engineers while providing technical direction for the design, analysis, integration, and validation of laser beamlines, diagnostics, optical coatings, adaptive optics systems, and other critical optical subsystems.

As a member of the engineering leadership team, you will partner closely with scientists, systems engineers, optical physicists, opto-mechanical engineers, and program leadership to ensure that the optical architectures, technical roadmaps, risks, and delivery of optical systems, is accomplished in accordance with the requirements of Xcimer's Fusion and Directed Energy missions. We are looking for a leader who combines exceptional technical depth with strong people leadership, execution discipline, and a passion for solving some of the world's most challenging engineering problems, while very comfortable working in a matrix organization.

Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, mentor, and grow the Optical Engineering team through hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
Establish team goals, priorities, staffing plans, and organizational capabilities aligned with company objectives.
Develop engineering processes, design standards, documentation practices, and quality expectations for the optical engineering organization.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Partner with executive leadership to develop long-term optical engineering strategy and organizational growth plans.

Technical Leadership

Oversee the development of optical architectures for laser beamlines, diagnostics, adaptive optics systems, beam transport systems, and related optical subsystems
Work with science, systems engineering, and laser teams to derive, allocate, and manage optical system requirements.
Provide technical oversight for optical design, tolerancing, alignment strategies, and system performance analyses.
Chair reviews of optical designs and analyses, ensuring technical rigor and adherence to performance requirements.
Guide development of active beam control systems including adaptive optics, beam stabilization, and tracking systems.
Ensure that requirements and specifications for optical components, coatings, imaging systems, cameras, sensors, and precision optical assemblies are established in compliance with the Xcimer Product Development Process
Drive resolution of complex optical performance issues through modeling, experimentation, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Oversee optical system integration, alignment, verification, validation, and commissioning activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with optomechanical engineering teams to optimize system performance, manufacturability, alignment accessibility, and maintainability.
Collaborate with optical physicists, electrical engineers, controls engineers, and software engineers to develop integrated laser and diagnostic systems.
Support supplier selection, technical evaluations, and strategic relationships with optical component vendors and manufacturing partners.
Work closely with program management to identify risks, develop mitigation plans, and ensure successful execution of program milestones.
Present technical status, risks, and recommendations to engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.

Qualifications

Education: MS degree in Optical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Experience: 10+ years of experience in optical engineering, including optical design, analysis, integration, and testing of complex optical systems.
Leadership: 15+ years of experience leading technical teams and managing engineering organizations.
Demonstrated expertise using optical design software such as Zemax (preferred), CODE V, or equivalent tools.
Strong experience with computational analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python, or similar engineering software.
Deep understanding of optical design methodologies, optimization techniques, and performance metrics for imaging and laser systems
Experience with optical tolerancing, fabrication specifications, statistical performance analysis, and alignment sensitivity assessments.
Experience integrating and aligning complex optical systems using instrumentation such as theodolites, autocollimators, laser trackers, interferometers, and related metrology equipment.
Experience performing optical metrology and characterization, including interferometric measurements, surface quality assessment, scatter characterization, and precision inspection techniques.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering efforts from concept through integration and testing.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired

Ph.D. degree in Optical Engineering, Optical Science, Physics, or a related discipline.
15+ years of experience in optical system design, optimization, tolerancing, integration, and precision alignment.
Experience working in a Matrix Organization delivering multiple projects and programs in parallel
Experience leading optical engineering organizations supporting large-scale technical programs.
Experience designing adaptive optics systems and beam pointing stabilization systems.
Experience performing high-fidelity physical optics modeling and wavefront propagation analyses in both near-field and far-field regimes.
Experience with high-energy laser systems and deep ultraviolet (UV) optical systems.
Experience developing comprehensive end-to-end optical system models and performance budgets.
Experience defining and flowing requirements from system-level architectures to subsystem and component specifications.
Experience supporting development of advanced scientific, aerospace, defense, fusion, or directed-energy systems.
Demonstrated success scaling engineering teams in fast-paced, high-growth technical organizations.

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Customer Deployments and Partner Integrations
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.

TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.

We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.

We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!

About The Role

With our Series B, we are entering our next chapter: building a full-stack video AI company with frontier models at the foundation, an enterprise platform in the middle, and agentic systems that turn raw video into actionable knowledge and insights.

Our customers include some of the world’s leading companies across media, sports, advertising, security, and the public sector. They are asking us to solve increasingly complex problems—not only through our APIs, but by deploying TwelveLabs technology securely and reliably into their environments.

As Director of Engineering, Deployment & Integrations, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for deploying TwelveLabs technology into our customers' and partners’ environments and integrating it deeply into their existing technology ecosystems.

You will own the engineering strategy and execution for customer and distribution partner deployments across hyperscalers, private cloud, on-premise, and other complex enterprise environments. You will work closely with our Engineering and Go to Market teams to turn complex customer requirements into scalable, repeatable deployment and integration capabilities.

This is a highly cross-functional and customer-facing engineering leadership role. You will be equally comfortable working through architecture with a customer's technical team, diving into a complex deployment or integration challenge, and building the systems and processes that allow the next customer to move faster.

Your goal is to make TwelveLabs easy to deploy, easy to integrate, and reliable to operate — while turning the lessons from each customer into capabilities that scale across the business.

In this role, you will focus on the core competencies listed below

Customer Deployment

Own the engineering lifecycle for customer and partner deployments, from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, production launch, and ongoing operations.
Lead deployments across public cloud, customer VPCs, private cloud, on-premise infrastructure, and other customer-controlled environments.
Partner directly with strategic customers, partners and their engineering, infrastructure, security, and IT teams to solve complex deployment challenges.
Establish the technical standards, tooling, and playbooks required to make deployments predictable and repeatable.
Turn recurring customer deployment requirements into scalable product and platform capabilities wherever possible.

Integrations & Enterprise Architecture

Own the engineering strategy for integrating TwelveLabs into customers' existing technology ecosystems.
Build scalable integration patterns across enterprise applications, data platforms, storage systems, identity and access management, APIs, and AI/ML infrastructure.
Partner with Product and Engineering to translate recurring customer integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
Establish standards and tooling that make integrations faster, more reliable, and increasingly self-service.
Balance customer-specific requirements with a long-term architecture that prevents TwelveLabs from accumulating one-off integrations.
Help define the technical architecture and interfaces that allow TwelveLabs to become deeply embedded in customer workflows and applications.

Deployment Automation & Developer Experience

Build the tooling, automation, and internal platforms that allow engineering teams to provision, configure, upgrade, integrate, and operate customer environments efficiently.
Develop deployment and integration architectures that move TwelveLabs from bespoke implementations toward repeatable, highly automated capabilities.
Establish strong CI/CD, release management, configuration management, and observability practices for distributed customer environments.
Create an exceptional internal developer experience for engineers responsible for building and supporting deployments and integrations.

Product & Engineering Partnership

Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure deployment and integration requirements are incorporated into product architecture from the beginning.
Identify recurring friction across customer deployments and integrations and turn those insights into product and platform improvements.
Partner with Research and ML teams to understand the operational requirements of serving increasingly capable multimodal models in production environments.
Help define the technical roadmap for deployment and integration infrastructure as TwelveLabs expands its product portfolio and customer footprint.

Customer, Partnerships & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a senior technical partner to Solutions Engineering, Sales, and Product on the most complex customer opportunities.
Translate customer requirements into clear technical decisions, engineering priorities, and execution plans.
Establish a strong operating rhythm across customer-facing and engineering teams to ensure deployments and integrations move quickly without compromising quality.
Communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly to both highly technical audiences and executive stakeholders.

Security, Compliance & Trust

Build deployment and integration architectures suitable for enterprise and public sector customers with demanding security and compliance requirements.
Partner with Security and Infrastructure teams to support requirements around data isolation, identity, access control, encryption, auditability, and compliance.
Help establish deployment patterns capable of supporting increasingly regulated and security-sensitive environments.

Team Building & Culture

Build and lead a world-class Deployment & Integrations Engineering organization.
Recruit, develop, and retain engineers who thrive at the intersection of distributed systems, infrastructure, product engineering, enterprise integrations, and customer problem-solving.
Create a culture of high ownership, technical excellence, urgency, and disciplined execution.
Establish the processes and operating mechanisms that allow the team to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for reliability and customer experience.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

10+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, platform engineering, or distributed systems, with significant experience leading globally distributed engineering teams.
Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for deploying complex software, AI/ML systems, or infrastructure into enterprise customer environments.
Deep technical understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployment systems.
Experience deploying software across multiple cloud environments and/or customer-controlled infrastructure, including air-gapped, disconnected, regulated, or highly secure environments
Hands-on experience owning the software deployment lifecycle end-to-end — versioning, release management, rollout + rollback strategy, upgrade paths, and post-deployment operations across distributed customer environments.
Deep experience with software packaging patterns for shipping into customer-controlled environments — container images, Helm charts, operator patterns, installer + bootstrap flows, air-gapped bundles, and dependency + configuration management.
A track record of turning bespoke customer implementations into scalable, repeatable engineering systems.
Strong customer-facing instincts and the ability to operate credibly with senior engineers, architects, security teams, and technical executives at large enterprises.
A bias toward action and a willingness to get into the technical details when the situation demands it.
Excellent judgment about when to build a one-off solution for a strategic customer versus investing in a scalable platform capability.
Experience operating in a high-growth startup where product requirements and customer needs evolve rapidly.
Experience working with globally distributed teams

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience deploying AI/ML or GPU-intensive workloads into customer environments.
Experience with public sector, defense, financial services, or other highly regulated customers.
Experience taking an enterprise deployment motion from bespoke implementations to a standardized platform.
Experience building or leading Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Deployment Engineering, or Professional Services Engineering organizations.

We are a global company that values the uniqueness of each person’s journey. The differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences are what allow us to challenge the status quo. We’re looking for people motivated by our mission and ready to help build the company that defines how the world understands video.

Benefits and Perks

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

🏥 Full health, dental, and vision benefits

🌴 Extremely flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years

💪 Monthly wellness stipend

📚 Annual Learning & Development stipend to invest in your growth

💼 Global offices in San Francisco, New York, and Seoul, and coworking office memberships for remote team members

🛂 VISA support where applicable

🚆 Transportation stipend (SF & NY onsite only)

🍲 Daily meals provided (SF & NY onsite only)

Compensation Range: $275K - $360K

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Experience Foundations - Confluent
new_jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. We put information in motion, streaming in near real time so organizations can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role:

We're seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to join our Experience Foundations team. This team owns critical TEAR (Trusted Experiences Access & Revenue) domains including Security UI, Networking UI, and Billing UI, as well as the shared experience foundations infrastructure (formerly UIF/UI Foundations team).

You'll lead the evolution of our foundations infrastructure from UI-only support to serving the entire Experience organization which includes several other interfaces (API/CLI/TF/VSCode/MCP). Along with this you will help establish patterns and best practices that enable UI engineers to confidently develop security and networking features across our application portfolio—including Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, and Tableflow.

In this role, you'll also support the evolution of Networking, Security, and Billing UI experiences, especially as we adopt and integrate the latest and greatest technologies in these domains. As cloud providers introduce new networking capabilities, security standards evolve, and billing models become more sophisticated, you'll ensure our UI stays at the forefront—providing intuitive, scalable interfaces that make complex technical capabilities accessible to our customers.

The Experience Foundations Team Owns Several Critical Pillars

Security: User authentication, authorization, and security experiences (RBAC, BYOK, SSO, API keys, encryption management)
Networking: Network configuration and connectivity interfaces (private networking, VPC peering, PrivateLink across AWS, GCP, Azure)
Billing UI: Revenue-critical billing and payment experiences (subscription models, multi-month commits, promotional offers, chargebacks, usage tracking
Experience Foundations Infrastructure: Shared UI/UX infrastructure and tooling (formerly UIF/UI Foundations), this includes our design system, compliance support, experience performance, accessibility and more.

These capabilities sit at the intersection of trust, infrastructure control, and revenue generation—foundational pillars that support our entire application ecosystem across Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products.

What You Will Do:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Establish clear, reusable patterns and best practices for UI engineers developing security and networking code
Elevate the impact of all UI engineers across multiple product teams (Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow)
Take a depth-first, hands-on approach to understanding systems and unblocking teams
Go deep in domain areas—understand the technical intricacies of networking protocols, security models, and billing systems to make sound architectural decisions
Drive the evolution of Experience Foundations infrastructure from UI-only to supporting the entire Experience organization, partner with the existing Engineering Manager to shape and execute the foundations roadmap

Cross-Functional Partnership

Own PM and Design partnerships for Security, Networking, and Billing domains
Ensure smooth execution and delivery of product initiatives across these verticals
Bridge technical and product perspectives to drive aligned outcomes
Translate domain complexity into clear execution plans
Challenge product specs when necessary to ensure technical feasibility
Partner with product teams across the portfolio to ensure patterns meet their needs
Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs transparently to senior leadership

Team & People Management

Collaborate with existing engineering leadership to build cohesive team strategy, including existing manager in the foundations space as your direct report
Mentor and develop engineers across multiple disciplines and experience levels
Foster a culture of ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement
Create leverage by empowering engineers with patterns, tools, and knowledge
Build strong connections between Experience Foundations and application teams
Champion developer productivity through AI tooling adoption, test automation, and improved engineering processes

Your work will enable UX engineers across our entire application portfolio to build consistent, high-quality security and networking experiences. By establishing clear patterns and evolving our foundations infrastructure, you'll multiply the impact of every engineer working on Governance, Flink, Kafka, Connect, Tableflow, and future products—while supporting the foundational pillars that drive over 70% of Confluent's revenue.

If you're energized by the challenge of transforming foundations infrastructure while elevating engineering capabilities across critical product domains, we'd love to talk.

Preferred Education

None

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
Strong hands-on technical background with ability to dive deep into complex systems
Deep frontend engineering expertise: Strong understanding of modern web development (React, TypeScript, component design systems)
Proven ability to distill complex technical domains into clear patterns and best practices
Experience creating reusable patterns/frameworks adopted across multiple teams or products
Track record of elevating team capabilities through mentorship and knowledge sharing
Demonstrated success partnering with Product and Design to drive execution
Experience managing or collaborating closely with other engineering managers
Experience managing multiple product areas or technical domains simultaneously

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience managing managers or leading leaders
Domain knowledge in at least one TEAR area: Security (RBAC, SSO, BYOK, encryption), Networking (VPC, PrivateLink, routing), or Billing/Payments (subscription models, usage tracking)
Experience evolving platform teams to serve broader organizational needs
Proficient with or highly curious about AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
Track record of driving developer productivity improvements through tooling, automation, or process innovation

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Obviant

The defense market is surging, but the data that drives it hasn't kept up. Companies, government, and investors are forced into heavily manual processes, stitching together hundreds of disparate sources to make decisions that carry real national security weight.

Obviant has built the data source of truth and the AI tooling for defense acquisition. We fuse thousands of structured and unstructured sources into a coherent picture of budget, programs, and the organizations running them. We have high satisfaction at top-tier customers, we're growing fast, we're backed by leading venture funds, and we're advised by veterans from national security and the technology industry.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to own one team end to end either our data engineering team or our product/web application team, depending on where your strengths land. You'll inherit an existing team and, as we grow, help expand it. Your hiring bar becomes the team's bar.

This is not a coordination role. You'll set the technical bar, run the delivery cadence, grow the engineers on your team, and stay close enough to the code to earn their respect.

We set obsessively high standards, and here that isn't a slogan. Our customers make acquisition and investment decisions on what we show them, so being roughly right is not a viable product. Others might say we're too particular about it. That's fine we're running our own race, not theirs.

We're looking for someone who pairs technical excellence with the ability to extend that practice into a team leader who stays credible in the work while multiplying it through others.

What You'll Own

Four areas below, with the understanding that the list is never complete. Nobody here says "that isn't my job."

Technical leadership

Set technical direction with your senior engineers, and guide the team through design tradeoffs, architecture decisions, and implementation quality
Own the engineering standards and the quality bar you decide what "good" means on your team and make it stick, without becoming the bottleneck
Raise the bar of the whole team, not just your own output. Mentor, review, and build a culture where quality is the default rather than a checklist someone enforces
Drop into a tactical role when it's the fastest way to unblock the team or land a business-critical outcome. Do, don't say

People growth

Develop engineers deliberately: real growth plans, direct feedback on a real cadence, and clear leveling conversations
Keep it all in the open. Deliver hard feedback with candor and empathy, face to face, never through backchannels
Make the hard calls with care and spine diagnose underperformance early, coach honestly, and handle exits with dignity for the person and clarity for the team
Hire and expand the team as we grow, holding the bar under pressure to fill seats
Manage up as well as down. Keep leadership and your peers ahead of what's coming, escalate early, and make sure nobody is ever caught off guard by your team's direction or risks

Team operations & delivery

Reach for culture before process. Ownership, high accountability, and zero excuses solve more than any ritual will add process only where culture alone can't carry the weight
Keep the rituals you do have honest: co-create them with the team, cut what's theater, and improve estimation and predictability over time
Run retros that close the loop improvements that ship and stick, not a list nobody revisits
Manage to a small set of meaningful health and delivery metrics, and guard against gaming them (velocity is a diagnostic, never a target)

Product & business alignment

Partner with whoever sits closest to the customer for your team Product, Design, and GtM if you're leading product engineering; analysts, AI/ML, and data consumers if you're leading data engineering. The partners shift; the customer obsession doesn't
Translate mission and business goals into clear engineering outcomes, and be able to explain to anyone how your team's work moves the business
Push back with conviction, clarity, and a willingness to have your mind changed
Keep the team focused and healthy when priorities shift, without becoming a silo

Required

What We're Looking For

7+ years of engineering experience, including substantial time leading and growing engineering teams
Real technical depth you can still demonstrate you can reason through a system design, spot the failure modes, and say what you'd cut to ship first
A track record of owning delivery for a team: planning, estimation, and reliable execution, including holding the line on performance, scalability, and technical debt
Direct experience with the hard parts of management hard feedback that landed, a struggling performer you diagnosed and worked, a real exit you ran well
Strong communication in every direction. You can push back on leadership, explain technical work to a non-technical audience, coach engineers, and over communicate before anyone has to ask
Comfortable with high autonomy and accountability in a fast-moving, early-stage environment. You're at home in ambiguity and you don't wait for direction
Strong references from current and prior roles

Nice to have

Experience building complex data or AI systems large-scale ingestion, pipeline orchestration, schema evolution, entity resolution or managing fast-moving web application teams
Background in government, defense tech, or another regulated environment
An active TS/SCI clearance, or eligibility to obtain one
Experience owning platform-level infrastructure from initial design through scaling it across multiple teams

How You'll Operate Here

Four traits show up in everything we do, and we'll probe for all four when we talk:

Bias for action: you move decisively with incomplete information. Action is the best medicine
Strong opinions, loosely held: you argue a clear point of view, then update quickly when the evidence changes. Intellectual honesty over ego
Continuous improvement: you measure how your team works, run real feedback loops, and close them
People growth: you develop engineers, give direct feedback, and handle the hard calls with both care and spine

Our Principles

We live these every day. If they don't sound like you, this won't be a fit and we'd both rather know now.

Impact. Our work matters. We take a lot of pride in building to advance mission outcomes.
Overdeliver. We go above and beyond in everything we do - creating products and serving our users
Hustle. We get stuff done, no matter what it takes.
Empathy. Our users’ problems are our own. We don't push products, we solve problems.
Humility. We’re not afraid to admit what we don’t know. Our job is to listen and grow.
Integrity. Transparency & respect above all else. It’s non-negotiable, even when it isn't easy

Compensation And Benefits

Base salary of $180,000 – $220,000, commensurate with experience
Early stage startup equity grant
Health, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible schedule and vacation time
Hybrid, based out of our office in the DC metro area

How We Hire

We run a full loop for a hire this Senior Engineering Manager starting with a hiring manager call, remote technical and leadership rounds, and an on-site that includes time with our CEO, so you meet your boss's boss before you decide. We commit to three weeks or less from the first interview to the final decision.

To apply, visit obviant.com/careers

Obviant is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering — Cloud, DevOps & AI Modernization (Onsite) Overland Park, KS
new_jobs.description:
About Netsmart

At Netsmart, we are focused on moving healthcare forward through technology that supports providers, clinicians, clients, and communities. As healthcare continues to evolve, our engineering teams are modernizing platforms, strengthening cloud-based delivery, improving DevOps practices, and exploring responsible AI-enabled capabilities that create meaningful value across our solutions.

About The Role

Netsmart is seeking a Vice President, Engineering — Cloud, DevOps & AI Modernization to lead software engineering teams through the next stage of modernization and scale. This is a senior engineering leadership role for someone who has grown through software development, understands how complex applications are built and operated, and can lead teams through cloud transformation, DevOps maturity, and AI-aware product evolution.

This leader will provide strategic and operational leadership across engineering, partnering closely with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, Data, and business stakeholders. The right candidate will bring strong software development credibility, cloud experience, DevOps leadership, a strong culture-first mindset, and experience working with global/offshore engineering teams, including teams in India.

This role is onsite in Overland Park, KS, and candidates must live in or relocate to the Greater Kansas City metro area.

What You’ll Do

Engineering Leadership & Culture

Lead and scale high-performing software engineering teams with a focus on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and delivery discipline.
Build a strong engineering culture rooted in ownership, trust, transparency, continuous improvement, and practical innovation.
Coach and develop engineering leaders and teams while creating clarity around priorities, expectations, decision-making, and execution.
Partner across Netsmart’s matrixed organization to align engineering priorities with business goals, client needs, product strategy, and operational commitments.
Serve as a credible, hands-on executive who can engage with teams at both the strategic and technical level.

Software Development & Modernization

Lead engineering execution across complex enterprise software platforms, balancing current-state application realities with future-state modernization goals.
Guide teams through legacy application modernization, platform scalability, service decomposition, API-first design, architectural simplification, and cloud-readiness.
Strengthen engineering practices across design, development, code quality, testing, security, reliability, observability, and production support.
Partner with architecture and engineering leaders to establish reusable patterns, standards, and practices that improve consistency and speed across teams.
Ensure teams can deliver stable, secure, scalable solutions while continuing to modernize core platforms over time.

Cloud, DevOps & Operational Excellence

Drive cloud and DevOps maturity across engineering teams, including CI/CD, automation, infrastructure-as-code, deployment reliability, monitoring, observability, and incident readiness.
Partner with DevOps, Cloud, Hosting, Security, and Infrastructure teams to improve how software is built, deployed, operated, and optimized.
Guide engineering teams in building cloud-enabled solutions with a strong understanding of AWS, distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, and cost awareness.
Promote engineering practices that improve release confidence, production stability, operational efficiency, and developer productivity.
Help teams move from project-based transformation toward sustainable cloud and DevOps operating models.

AI-Aware Engineering & Future-Ready Development

Help engineering teams understand where AI, automation, analytics, and data-driven capabilities can responsibly improve products, workflows, development practices, and operational outcomes.
Partner with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and Architecture leaders to evaluate AI-enabled opportunities with appropriate governance, privacy, security, and risk considerations.
Support practical adoption of AI concepts in engineering, including intelligent automation, developer productivity, data-driven decision-making, and responsible AI-enabled product capabilities.
Balance innovation with execution discipline, ensuring AI opportunities are connected to measurable business, client, and product value.

Global Engineering Partnership

Lead effectively across distributed and global engineering teams, including teams in India.
Create strong alignment, communication rhythms, ownership models, and delivery expectations across U.S. and India-based teams.
Build trust and accountability across locations while ensuring teams are connected to shared architecture, engineering standards, product priorities, and delivery outcomes.
Operate successfully in a matrixed organization where influence, collaboration, and clarity are essential.

What You’ll Bring

Senior engineering leadership experience, ideally at the VP, Senior Director, Director, or equivalent level leading software engineering teams at scale.
Strong foundation in software development, software engineering leadership, application architecture, or technical delivery.
Experience leading complex enterprise software development organizations through modernization, cloud adoption, DevOps maturity, or platform transformation.
Strong understanding of AWS/cloud-based architecture, distributed systems, APIs, application modernization, cloud operations, scalability, reliability, and security.
Demonstrated experience advancing DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, observability, production readiness, and operational excellence.
Ability to lead engineering teams through ambiguity while creating clear priorities, execution plans, success measures, and accountability.
Experience partnering with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Security, Compliance, Data, and business leaders in a matrixed environment.
Experience working with India-based offshore or global capability center teams.
Practical understanding of AI concepts and how AI, automation, and data-driven capabilities can support product innovation and engineering optimization.
Strong culture leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and people development skills.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
Must be onsite in Overland Park, KS and based in or willing to relocate to the Greater Kansas City metro area.

Preferred Experience

Healthcare technology, EHR, post-acute care, human services, behavioral health, revenue cycle, or regulated industry experience.
Experience leading cloud modernization or application transformation across legacy enterprise platforms.
Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, event-driven architecture, infrastructure-as-code, platform engineering, or modern data platforms.
Experience improving engineering operating models across U.S. and India-based teams.
Exposure to AI/ML, LLMs, MLOps, responsible AI practices, intelligent automation, or AI-assisted developer productivity.
Experience leading through organizational change while maintaining delivery commitments and production stability.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted engineering executive who can lead people, technology, and transformation with clarity and credibility. You will help Netsmart strengthen software engineering execution, modernize complex platforms, improve cloud and DevOps maturity, and prepare teams for responsible AI-enabled innovation.

You will be known for building strong engineering culture, creating operational discipline, partnering effectively across a matrixed organization, and leading both U.S. and India-based teams with alignment, accountability, and trust.

Why Netsmart

At Netsmart, you will help shape technology that supports healthcare providers, clinicians, organizations, and communities. This role offers the opportunity to lead meaningful engineering modernization work in a mission-driven company where cloud, DevOps, and AI-aware innovation are central to how we continue moving healthcare forward.

Netsmart is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all associates. All employment decisions at Netsmart, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion and transfer, are based on performance, qualifications, abilities, education and experience. Netsmart does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, past or present military service, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

new_jobs.description:
About Viam

Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We're inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.

We're a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.

About the Role

Hybrid 3 days/week in NYC office, with occasional travel to customer sites

We're looking for a Director of Forward Deployed Engineering to lead the team responsible for getting Viam's customers into production. You'll manage a team of five engineers working across our most strategic accounts, own the technical approach to each deployment, and serve as the senior technical partner to our customers' engineering and operations leaders.

This is a leadership role for someone who is still technical. You'll spend your time on architecture decisions, design reviews, coaching, and customer conversations. Prior professional robotics experience isn't required, but you should be comfortable around hardware and physical systems, and able to get fluent in a new platform quickly.

What you'll own:

Manage a team of five forward deployed engineers: coaching, performance, hiring, and how they are resourced across accounts.
Own the technical approach across deployments and make the architecture and prioritization calls.
Be the senior technical voice with customer leadership, from kickoff through escalation.
Work with Viam leadership on account direction, and keep them current on progress, risks, and blockers.
Drive deployments to production: hold the schedule, unblock what's stuck, and change approach when a site demands it.
Turn field learnings into platform priorities with Product and Engineering.

What you bring:

Experience managing engineers who deploy software in customer environments.
Deep systems experience and the ability to get fluent in an unfamiliar platform quickly. You can review a design and read code, though you won't be coding day to day.
Judgment across systems integration, SDKs, and edge/cloud architectures, including what breaks when networks and hardware are unreliable.
A track record with enterprise customers, including the credibility to hold a hard conversation with their leadership.
Comfort deciding with incomplete information and owning the outcome.
Experience building structure where none existed, in an environment where most of the work is still bespoke.
Willingness to balance one customer's urgency against what scales across the portfolio.

Experience With Robotics Or IoT Is Not Required.

The salary for this role is between $225,000 - $275,000 /year.

Full-time Benefits

Viam's base salary range for this role is posted above. In addition to cash compensation, Viam offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants, health benefits, and more.

100% covered medical/dental/vision insurance plans, commuter benefits
25 days paid vacation and generous holiday observances
Free lunch every day that you're in the office
One Medical Membership
Citi Bike memberships
Monthly wellness stipend to be used for a variety of fitness-related items like gym memberships, fitness classes, fitness equipment, and more
Paid parental leave
Reproductive Health Benefits, including Fertility Benefits and Abortion Access Travel Benefits
Yearly Learning and Development Budget for your own personal learning goals

Values:

Vision Driven
Collaborate Openly
Act Decisively
Succeed Through Diversity
Hold Ourselves Accountable
Lead with Curiosity

Viam does not accept unsolicited agency resumes or calls from recruitment agencies or search firms. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or Viam employees. Viam is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Manager of Test Engineering to lead a critical program supporting the company’s AI and autonomy efforts. In this role, you will shape the test strategy, quality standards, and execution model for intelligent systems that power the next generation of connected, autonomous, and software-defined machines. This leader will guide cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges, build AI tools that improve software testing products, advance modern test automation and AI-enabled quality practices, and ensure Caterpillar delivers safe, reliable, and scalable technology for customers working in the world’s most demanding environments.

What You Will Do

Define and own the end‑to‑end AI testing strategy, including frameworks, tooling, quality gates, and automation approaches for machine‑learning and traditional software systems.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software test leads, setting clear expectations, elevating technical depth, and fostering a culture of quality engineering excellence.
Architect scalable AI test solutions, such as model‑validation pipelines, data‑quality checks, bias and drift detection, and performance benchmarking for AI/ML models.
Partner with engineering, product, and data science leaders to align testing practices with roadmap priorities, ensuring AI features meet reliability, safety, and compliance standards.
Drive continuous improvement across test operations, introducing modern automation, observability, and tooling that increase coverage, speed, and defect detection accuracy.
Establish governance and best practices for AI quality, including documentation standards, risk assessments, and audit‑ready processes for regulated or high‑impact systems.

What You Will Have

Organizational Leadership: Knowledge of leadership concepts and ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives.
Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements.
Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace.
Software Integration Engineering: Knowledge of software integration processes and functions; ability to design, develop and maintain interfaces and linkage to alternative platforms and software packages.
Software Test Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design.
Software Quality Assurance and Testing: Knowledge of software quality assurance and testing; ability to apply appropriate processes, tools, and techniques for assuring a high level of quality in computer software products and systems.

Top Candidates Will Also Have

Background: Typical candidate will have 15+ years of software engineering experience with 7+ years leading test engineering teams
Gen AI Assisted Development: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or automated agent workflows) to accelerate code generation, boilerplate reduction, and automated testing across multiple teams. Demonstrated experience with AI Test architecture
Managing Managers: Demonstrated ability to lead and develop engineering managers, setting clear expectations, coaching through complexity, and ensuring consistent execution, talent growth, and accountability across multiple teams.
Vision & Execution at Scale: Proven ability to set a clear platform and engineering vision and drive multiple complex initiatives in parallel through a large organization of 30+ software test engineers, aligning teams, managing dependencies, and delivering outcomes with consistency and accountability.
Experience with tools such as Java, AWS bedrock, playwright, karat, ect..

Additional Details

This position requires the candidate to be based in Chicago, IL
Relocation assistance is NOT available for this position
Visa sponsorship is NOT available for this position

$159,120.00 - $258,570.00

Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

new_jobs.description:
Job Title:
Executive Director, Platform Architecture
Location:
Chicago, IL (Onsite – Hybrid - 3 days in a week)
Position Type:
Fulltime permanent position

Responsibilities:

Qualifications:
The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the primary functions.

Required:
12+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or systems architecture, with at least 3 years in a people leadership or team lead role
Demonstrated experience defining and governing infrastructure architecture standards across multiple domains at organizational scale
Broad, hands-on knowledge across infrastructure domains:
cloud (AWS), on-premises data center, networking, compute, storage, and container platforms
Deep experience with AWS architecture — VPCs, EC2, EKS, MSK, S3, IAM, KMS, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and security services
Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes — cluster architecture, workload design, multi-tenancy, networking (CNI), and operational patterns at scale
Experience with Apache Kafka as enterprise streaming infrastructure — deployment, operations, and topology design
Demonstrated experience leading GitOps and infrastructure-as-code programs — Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent
Experience with hybrid and on-premises/cloud connectivity architecture — network design, routing,firewalling, and security zoning
Ability to lead through influence and authority — building alignment across Engineering, Security, Operations, and Governance
Strong communication skills — able to represent infrastructure strategy to executive leadership and translate architecture decisions into actionable standards for engineering teams

Preferred:
Experience in financial services, particularly regulated environments (SIFMU, clearinghouse, exchange, or bank)
Familiarity with Regulation SCI, CPMI-IOSCO, or equivalent financial market infrastructure regulatory frameworks and their implications for infrastructure design
Experience with Apache Flink or equivalent stream processing frameworks in production environments
Experience with enterprise observability platforms — OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or equivalent
Familiarity with low-latency and high-performance computing patterns relevant to risk and clearing workloads AWS Solutions Architect — Professional certification or equivalent
Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF

Technical Skills:
Cloud: AWS foundational and advanced services — EC2,
EKS, MSK, S3, VPC, IAM, KMS, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, CloudWatch
Container platforms: Kubernetes (EKS or self-managed),
Docker, Helm, container networking (CNI)
Streaming and processing: Apache Kafka, Apache Flink
GitOps and IaC: Terraform, ArgoCD, Flux, Helm, GitHub Actions or Jenkins
Networking: routing protocols, firewalling, load balancing,
DNS, hybrid connectivity, network security zoning
Storage: block, object, and file storage architecture; backup and recovery patterns
Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or equivalent
Unix/Linux environments; artifact management (Nexus, Artifactory)

Education and/or Experience:
BS degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of relevant work experience.

Certificates or Licenses:
AWS Solutions Architect — Associate or Professional (preferred)

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each primary duty satisfactorily.
Lead the Platform Architecture Team
Lead, develop, and set direction for a team of principal architects covering cloud, on-premises infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, and observability domains
Own the Platform Architecture vision: deliver the resilient, scalable foundation upon which critical market functions depend — making resilience the default, not the exception
Ensure individual architect domain expertise is synthesized into coherent, enterprise-wide platform standards — not siloed recommendations
Manage team priorities, capacity, and delivery against architecture commitments across programs and initiatives Develop team members through coaching, feedback, and exposure to enterprise-scale architectural challenges

Define and Govern Platform Architecture Standards:
Establish and maintain authoritative platform architecture standards spanning cloud (AWS), on-premises data center, hybrid connectivity, networking, compute, storage, and container platforms
Define reference architectures and infrastructure patterns that Engineering and application teams can consume without requiring per-project architecture engagement Own non-functional requirements standards at the platform level — availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, latency, throughput, and capacity — as first-class concerns applicable across all tiers of Client's system portfolio
Enforce platform standards through Architecture Review Board participation and design review processes
Maintain infrastructure architecture documentation, ADRs, and transition plans that accurately reflect current and target state
Drive Infrastructure Modernization and Cloud Strategy
Own Client's infrastructure architecture strategy for cloud adoption — defining what moves to AWS, what remains on-premises, and how hybrid connectivity is structured
Ensure cloud architecture patterns for networking, security, identity, and compute are consistent, compliant, and operationally sound across all workloads Drive GitOps and infrastructure-as-code adoption — pipeline standards, environment promotion, configuration management, and secrets management at enterprise scale
Lead architecture direction for container platform (Kubernetes/EKS), streaming infrastructure (Kafka), and stream processing (Flink) as foundational platform capabilities
Identify and systematically reduce infrastructure risk — single points of failure, end-of-life dependencies, capacity constraints, and gaps in recovery capabilities

Partner Across the Organization:
Serve as the primary platform architecture partner to Application Architecture, ensuring application designs are grounded in platform reality and platform capabilities evolve to meet application needs
Collaborate with Engineering, Security, and Operations to ensure platform architecture decisions are implementable, operable, and aligned to security requirements
Engage with Technology Leads, program management, and senior leadership to represent platform architecture in strategic planning, budgeting, and vendor decisions
Coordinate with Governance/Risk and Compliance to ensure platform architecture satisfies Client's regulatory obligations under Regulation SCI and CPMI-IOSCO resilience principles

Ensure Operational Resilience:
Establish observability standards — metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting — as platform-level capabilities delivered to all application teams
Define and govern disaster recovery, business continuity, and resilience architecture across infrastructure domains
Drive capacity planning and performance engineering practices; ensure the platform is sized and architected ahead of demand, not reactive to it
Lead platform architecture participation in incident postmortems; ensure operational findings drive durable infrastructure improvements
